title: Absolutely impossible to drink out of cleanly. Spills all over you
text:
Absolutely impossible to drink out of cleanly. Spills all over you. This cup is an absolute disaster waiting to happen. Do not even think about drinking hot coffee or hot tea with it - you will get burned as it sloshes out onto your face. Cold drinks aren't any better.

The problem is the 360 degree access on the lid. This is badly engineered and essentially useless for actual drinking. The multiple openings are long and narrow all the way around the lid and you cannot insert a straw to minimize the spillage. Once you tip the cup to drink you initially get a tiny trickle and then a full face flood as the liquid reaches the rest of the lid openings and rushes out. (See photos) For Heaven's sake, do not drop or tip it as you walk or you'll be cleaning a mess - totally not useful in a car.

The container part is a really pretty deep red and it does keep drinks cold. My only choice now is to just use this cup as a thermos rather than trying to drink out of it. I'm giving it an extra star for being useful in at least one way.

product_metadata.title: Thermos Stainless King 20 oz Travel Tumbler with 360 Degree Drink Lid, Cranberry
features: Thermos vacuum insulation technology for maximum cold temperature retention; Keeps liquids cold for up to 20 hours
360 Degree drink lid allows you to drink from anywhere on the lid; Lid is made from BPA free Eastman Tritan
Press fit lid is easy to drink from and stays securely in place
Sweat proof design won't leave water rings; Fits most cup holders
Durable stainless steel interior and exterior; 20 ounce capacity
description: An ideal choice for people on the go, the Stainless King Vacuum Insulated 20 Ounce Tumbler is built to last and loaded with features to make for a more enjoyable drinking experience. Thermos vacuum insulation technology virtually eliminates temperature change within the beverage container by creating an airless space between two stainless steel walls. The result is an insulation layer that performs better than any other. A superior insulated container you can depend on to keep your beverages hotter, colder, fresher, longer. This 20 Ounce tumbler keeps beverages cold up to 20 hours making it a great choice for long days out and about, in the office or relaxing at home. Constructed with double wall stainless steel, this 20 ounce tumbler is durable, yet its sleek design is both eye-catching and functional. The contoured body shape is easy to grip and fits most automobile cup holders. The Stainless King 20 Ounce Tumbler comes equipped with a 360 Degree drink lid with a press fit which securely stays in place and allows you to drink from anywhere on the lid. And because of the double wall insulation, the stainless steel body stays condensation-free with cold beverages. In order to maximize the incredible insulation technology, it is recommended to pre-chill the tumbler just prior to use. This can be accomplished by filling the tumbler with cold water, attaching the lid and letting it rest for a few minutes. Before you are ready to use, simply empty the water and fill with your favorite beverage.
